chrome_hint: eBay AU sold+completed: '14ct yellow gold wide band ring 6mm' and '14k gold court band 6mm grams' (check price per gram, 5-8 g); Terapeak same; eBay AU sold '14ct gold band'. Also current spot gold AUD per gram x 0.585 for melt value, and a dealer buy price (e.g. Gold Corp / local gold buyer). Noble Numismatics archive and Gray's Online sold 'gold band 14ct' for auction comps; LiveAuctioneers sold '14k gold wide band'.
viewing_check: Weigh the ring and read the inside stamp with a loupe (14ct / 585 / 14K, maker mark); test with acid or magnet if unmarked; note ring size and any thin or dented spots. Weight in grams settles most of the value.
